calibration.type: one-time static uniform similarity transform raw core pixel coordinates to source-rest screen coordinates
calibration.provenance: Read-only four-visible-feature fit reported by the engineer; preparation cross-check uses approximate observed hat apex, left/right brim extrema and lower tunic hem correspondences listed here. Fit residuals reported as 2.96–6.40 source-rest px; proposal remains unsealed.
calibration.root_pivot_note: Fixed full-character ground pivot; core part remains at its calibrated rest coordinates. A producer toe estimate is not substituted for the root.

attachment_proposals.kind: authored cloth attachment convention on visible cap
attachment_proposals.evidence: Point falls inside the broad ivory shoulder-cap cloth, inset from its visible outer corner and below the top shoulder slope. It is a practical arm-underlap seam convention, not a measured anatomical shoulder joint.

visual_diagnosis.observed: Core has a broad sleeveless tunic shoulder cap on both sides; approximate alpha>128 outer contour around x397–852 at y440, tapering with the shoulder slope. These bounds describe cloth silhouette, not joints.
visual_diagnosis.scale: Parent review estimated core hat width about500 vs canonical ~330, shoulder span about448 vs ~312, and lower hem about1215 vs ~846. A single uniform scale near0.673 brings overall hat/hem occupancy toward canonical proportions.
